chunks: Beware! Satan has certainly stripped his party of its strength and collected his forces in order that oppression may return to its homeland.
And wrong may come back to its position. By Allah, they have not put a correct blame on me, nor have they done justice between me and themselves.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about Satan's role in the accusations against him?
ai.summary: In this passage from the Sermon of the Accusers, Imam Ali (AS) characterizes the political opposition as agents of Satan seeking to re-establish the pre-Islamic era of injustice (Jahiliyyah) through the distortion of truth. He asserts that their accusations were not based on genuine moral objection but were driven by partisan bias, as they neither found valid fault in his governance nor treated him with impartiality in their judgment.
